edges.reason: transfer() uses _msgSender() as the source of the token movement.
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender for the allowance decrement.
The 'from' address of _transfer is caller-controlled through _msgSender().
The constructor assigns _owner and _taxWallet from msg.sender.
onlyTaxCollector compares _taxWallet with msg.sender before addToWhitelist executes.
lowerTax is gated by onlyTaxCollector which compares with msg.sender.
transfer() invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() calls _approve to reduce the remaining allowance.
approve() delegates the allowance write to _approve.
Parameter from is consumed by _transfer.
Parameter to is consumed by _transfer.
Parameter amount is consumed by _transfer.
Parameter recipient flows into transfer().
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer to settle balances.
Parameter sender of _tokenTransfer drives the debit leg.
Parameter recipient of _tokenTransfer drives the credit leg.
Parameter tAmount is split into team fee and transfer amount.
Parameter taxRate scales the extracted team fee.
The transfer amount is forwarded as tAmount into _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer writes sender, recipient and contract entries of _balance.
_taxFee feeds the taxRate argument used in the fee multiplication/division.
_maxTxAmount is enforced as the buy-size limit inside _transfer.
_owner is compared against from/to to decide whether fee logic applies.
_transfer calls owner() to obtain the current owner address.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
_transfer conditionally calls swapTokensForEth on the accumulated contract balance.
swapTokensForEth passes tokenAmount into the external router swap call.
The external router swap happens before _tokenTransfer settles balances, allowing a reentrant transfer back into _transfer.
Parameter tokenAmount is the swap input amount.
swapTokensForEth calls _approve to authorise the router.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract ETH balance exceeds TAX_THRESHOLD.
sendETHToFee performs the ETH transfer to _taxWallet.
The ETH transfer to the tax wallet executes an external callable fallback that can re-enter sendETHToFee/_transfer.
Parameter amount is the ETH quantity forwarded.
_taxWallet is the recipient of the fee ETH transfer.
_taxWallet is compared with _msgSender() in the onlyTaxCollector-gated paths and used for fee accounting.
The arbitrary external call O(ROUTER_ADDRESS).amount() executes inside _transfer before balances are updated.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, making execution window miner-dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
createUniswapPair reads _uniswap to obtain factory and WETH.
createUniswapPair assigns the newly created pair to _pair.
createUniswapPair calls the external factory createPair.
The external createPair call returns control to the creator contract before _pair is assigned.
createUniswapPair grants the router an unlimited pair allowance.
addLiquidity forwards contract ETH into the router addLiquidityETH call.
The external addLiquidityETH call can re-enter before the _swapEnabled/_canTrade flags are set.
addLiquidity enables the automatic swap flag.
addLiquidity opens trading by setting _canTrade.
addLiquidity reads balanceOf(address(this)) from _balance as the token amount.
addToWhitelist sets _isExcludedFromFee for the given address.
removeFromWhitelist clears _isExcludedFromFee for the given address.
Parameter buyer is written into the fee-exemption mapping.
lowerTax overwrites the _taxFee state variable.
Parameter newTaxRate becomes the new fee value.
removeBuyLimit sets _maxTxAmount to the whole supply.
swapForTax calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
swapForTax reads balanceOf(address(this)).
collectTax calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
renounceOwnership emits the transfer event using the current _owner.
renounceOwnership zeroes the _owner state variable.

Constructor instantiates the Uniswap router interface.

_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to decide the applicable tax rate.
_pair is compared against from/to inside _transfer.

swapForTax is gated by onlyTaxCollector which checks _taxWallet.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only carries a debit address into the internal transfer routine and has no independent semantic identity.
The to parameter only carries a credit address into the internal transfer routine.
The amount parameter is the token quantity consumed by _transfer and its fee split.
The sender parameter is the direct input to the balance debit performed by _tokenTransfer.
The recipient parameter is the direct input to the balance credit performed by _tokenTransfer.
tAmount is the gross quantity split inside _tokenTransfer.
taxRate controls the fee arithmetic executed by _tokenTransfer.
newTaxRate is the sole argument written into the _taxFee state variable by lowerTax.
buyer is the sole key toggled in the fee-exemption mapping by the whitelist function.
tokenAmount is the direct input to the router swap call made by swapTokensForEth.
amount is the ETH value transferred to the tax wallet by sendETHToFee.
amount flows straight from approve() into _approve.
spender flows straight from approve() into _approve.
account is only a read key for the _balance mapping in balanceOf.
recipient is forwarded directly from transfer() into _transfer.
contractTokenBalance exists solely as the input amount for the swapTokensForEth call, which maps to the external router swap operation.
contractETHBalance is used only as the amount forwarded to sendETHToFee, which performs the ETH transfer operation.
contractBalance is the local alias of the contract token balance passed to swapTokensForEth by swapForTax.
